correctness.rationale: For each d>=2 take |Phi_d>=d^{-1/2}sum_j|jj>. The normalized Choi state of any unitary U is the rank-one projector onto (I⊗U)|Phi_d>, hence every such channel has eigenvalues (1,0,...,0), independent of U. The target-relative entanglement fidelity equals |Tr(U)|^2/d^2; the Haar-average identity F_avg=(d F_e+1)/(d+1) therefore yields F_avg(U)=(|Tr U|^2+d)/(d(d+1)). U=I gives 1; U=diag(1,omega,...,omega^{d-1}) with omega=e^{2πi/d} gives 1/(d+1). Source Appendix B.4 instead uses (d+sum λ_i²)/(d(d+1)), producing 1/d with normalized pure Choi and producing 1 with the unnormalized Choi spectrum (d,0,...), so neither convention rescues the formula. This is a universal algebraic contradiction, not an inference from dimensions 2–12. Verified actual appendix and its separate correct identity in main section and pseudocode.
